title: Petition of Massachusetts Electric Company for a determination by the Department that the present situation of certain lands in the City of Beverly and the proposed construction, maintenance and operation of lines for the transmission of electricity at 23 kV between the Petitioner's underground circuit #2361 in McPherson Drive and the Petitioner's Balch Street substation, all in the City of Beverly, are reasonably necessary for the convenience and welfare of the public and that such lands and the facilities to be built and maintained thereon by exempted from the operation of the zoning ordinance of the City of Beverly to the extent applicable.
petitioner: Massachusetts Electric Company d/b/a National Grid
